name: dimathjayasinghe/wsrv-chat-demo
description: A tiny chat app: accounts, login, logout and live messages over WebSockets, built on the wsrv PHP package.

scripts-descriptions.install-lib: Download and verify the native wsrv library into ./lib
scripts-descriptions.serve: Run the web app on http://127.0.0.1:8000
scripts-descriptions.chat: Run the WebSocket chat server on ws://127.0.0.1:8081
scripts-descriptions.db: Start the MariaDB container (schema loaded on first start)
